task.title: Enabling and disabling SRAM support in the DataRecoveryService
task.shortdesc: SRAM support is provided by the DataRecoveryService, a platform service that applies to SRAM-equipped nc controllers.

taskbody.prereq: You are using and are connected to a remote station.

step.cmd: In the Nav tree, expand the station’s ServicesPlatformServices, and double-click DataRecoveryService.
step.stepresult:
The Data Recovery Service Editor window opens.
By default, the Service Enabled property is true. This is appropriate since the controller has no backup battery installed.

step.cmd: If a battery-less controller is powered from a battery-backed UPS, you could also choose to set Service Enabled to false.
step.stepresult: If you set Service Enable to false, the DataRecoveryService no longer records runtime database changes to SRAM but depends entirely on its backup battery to preserve station data upon a power loss!

step.cmd: To write the configuration to the host platform, click Save.
step.stepresult: You are prompted to reboot now to apply the changes.

step.cmd: To reboot with the change in the DataRecoveryService (disabled or enabled) made effective, click Yes.
